escalations.question: The 'GSA + Rollvis together hold >50% of the high-precision planetary roller-screw world market' claim (carried qualitatively on humanoid_planetary_roller_screw and in task_humanoid_roller_screw_swiss_corner) is NOT stated on either firm's primary site — Rollvis says only 'a world leader', GSA says only 'in-house in Switzerland', neither gives a %. The breadth agent traced the >50% figure to SEO/vendor blogs (screw-tech, kggfa) which are banned for numbers (acceptance-standard B5 / brief §4.5). Need one primary or two independent quality sources (IFR / interact-analysis / TrendForce / Yole / Reuters-class) for any >50% combined-Swiss-share assertion, or keep it qualitative. Which authoritative source, if any, states the >50% world-market share at a named basis?

The 'Tesla Optimus sources GSA's RGTI 12.8 inverted roller screw' sourcing claim (in task_humanoid_roller_screw_swiss_corner and GSA node/edge claim text) is NOT on GSA's primary site (no Tesla/Optimus mention) and was traced by the breadth agent to SEO/vendor blogs only. A specific named-customer (Tesla->GSA) claim needs one primary or two independent quality sources. Which authoritative source confirms Tesla Optimus sources GSA's RGTI, or should the Tesla->GSA sourcing stay an unasserted candidate?

tickerAudit.source: GSA AG / Gewinde Satelliten Antriebe AG (est. 1982), spun from Gewinde Ziegler AG (Horriwil, Solothurn; thread grinding since 1932). Rollvis SA, Geneva/Plan-les-Ouates, founded 1970 (rollvis.com/about-us; D&B, Crunchbase, CB Insights profiles). Privately held; no exchange listing or listed parent found. private is correct.
Drake Manufacturing Services Co., Warren, Ohio, est. 1972 (drakemfg.com; gearsolutions.com profile; BBB lists 'Drake Manufacturing LLC'). Privately held; no public listing found. private is correct.

Not a wrong ticker, an incomplete listing characterization.
